# Independent control family

`weather` was authored separately from the four generator families. Its vocabulary
must not be copied into runtime lexical data to improve this particular score.
It combines renamed lowercase phrases with opposite measurement roles and units.

The evaluator reports its correspondence quality separately. Generic regression
invariants apply to every run; its recall is descriptive rather than a threshold
selected after observing these examples. Once a case is inspected and used to change
the algorithm, it becomes a regression fixture rather than an untouched holdout.
